HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW:MASTER LOUEY (2) is a consistent, smart performer for Jayne Davies. He is racing well and will be able to take advantage of a positive race map from barrier two. SPORTS NARRATOR (3) is first-up here, but this is a drop in class from the races he contested before his spell. He has nice ability and the best sectional times in this event. EL LAZZAR (7) has been impressive since joining Lochie Cook’s stable, winning two of his last three starts. He will need to make his own luck from barrier seven, but he is a versatile horse. BLACK OPAL JACK (10) is second-up and is likely to improve on his first-up third at Terang, where he ran home well from a long way back. BACK: MASTER LOUEY (2)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MASTER LOUEY (2), SPORTS NARRATOR (3), EL LAZZAR (7), BLACK OPAL JACK (10)

OVERVIEW:HAPPILY (8) is a talented mare for Amy Day. She showed her class three starts ago in a Vicbred Super Series heat, finishing third behind The Art Of Success and Wicked Confession. She broke under pressure in the Final, but it was a brilliant race in which she remained competitive. Last start, she sprinted late to finish second behind Jilliby Sniper, who went on to win well at Melton on Saturday night. Her barrier is tricky, but she is the class runner. LANIKAI WARRIOR (2) has had only two career starts and looks to be a progressive type. He was good last start when finishing third behind Hoso Magic, improving on his debut effort. If he takes another step forward, he will be competitive from the barrier. MY MARIONETTE (4) let down nicely last start at Melton. With the right run, she will be flashing home. BUNGY (6) is a better horse than his numerical form suggests. He showed plenty of promise early in his career, and if he brings his best, he will be right in this. Also respecting KATUNTI (5), who has won her last two starts this preparation, although this is a tougher assignment from a tricky barrier. BACK: HAPPILY (8)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: HAPPILY (8), LANIKAI WARRIOR (2), MY MARIONETTE (4), BUNGY (6)

OVERVIEW:REASON TO LAUGH (8) has been racing well. Although well beaten into second last start, he did let down nicely. He has a good record with Michael Bellman in the sulky. As the only horse on the back row, he has the option to stay on the fence or move into the running line. KIMCHI (7) has been in good form and won nicely last start. He enjoyed a good run before storming home late. This is a tougher assignment from the wide front-row barrier. NORMANDY NUGGET (4) has been racing well. He won two starts ago when leading, then did it tough in the breeze last start and still fought on well for third. He may need to make his own luck again here. ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (2) can capitalise on the better barrier against her main rivals. She doesn't have enough gate speed to easily cross THE HEATS ON LEXY (1), but she shouldn't get too far back. SELECTIONS: REASON TO LAUGH (8), KIMCHI (7), ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (2), NORMANDY NUGGET (4)

OVERVIEW: This is a very even field, and the result is likely to come down to luck and suitable barrier positions. ENABLE ME (2) is first-up since April but won a recent trial at Kyabram. He was fair when finishing fourth at his last start before going for a spell, using the sprint lane and holding his ground up the straight. I am expecting improvement after the freshen-up, although fitness is a query. PICKLE IT (7) is racing better than his numerical form suggests. He had a very tough run in the breeze last start at Cranbourne and only tired in the very late stages. He faces a tricky barrier here, but a win wouldn't surprise me with some luck. FREAK OUT (1) looks well placed from barrier one. He has enough gate speed to hold a forward position early and will be suited if they run a solid tempo without producing a blistering last quarter. ROBLEN RANGER (3) let down nicely to finish second last start at Melton. He is in good form and, with some luck, is a winning chance here. HIWAYTHREENINENINE (5) is first-up in the state for new trainer Chris Romanidis. He will need to improve on his previous form to win, but the change of scenery could help. SELECTIONS: ENABLE ME (2), PICKLE IT (7), FREAK OUT (1), ROBLEN RANGER (3)

OVERVIEW: This is an interesting race, featuring horses with more than 15 career wins alongside others still chasing their maiden victories. One of the maidens, WHIRILY MAURZ (5), was a good second first-up for Andy Gath last start. She flashed home from well back to finish second, and I am expecting improvement here. ICANMOTOR (7) is a 20-time winner who is a consistent performer, although he faces a tricky barrier. IMAGUNNARESTNGO (1) lacked early speed last start and quickly settled at the rear of the field, but flashed home late to finish third. He needs to hold his ground early here to capitalise on his barrier. SIR CANDY CLOUD (4) battled on for fourth last start after racing in front. If he can map well here, he can capitalise. ELLI JOH (6) is racing well and cannot be left out of calculations. BLISSFULL LILLY (2) is one to watch early, given her good gate speed. BACK: WHIRILY MAURZ (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: WHIRILY MAURZ (5), ICANMOTOR (7), IMAGUNNARESTNGO (1), SIR CANDY CLOUD (4)

OVERVIEW:YANKEE RAIN (6) is in great form, having won two of her last three starts. She finished second last start, but it was a good run, and she let down nicely late. The barrier is awkward, but she has the confidence. ROYLANCE (4) is second-up here. He was safely held when first-up but looked to be travelling well. He is a nice horse. James Herbertson drove him in a recent trial and takes the reins for the first time in race conditions. BONA KHAN (3) is a high-speed horse who looks likely to lead early. With a good run, he is a winning chance, although I prefer him over the shorter trip. THEROUX (1) is a nice horse who is racing well and has the ace barrier here. I am also expecting an improved performance from YANKEE GAMBLER (2), who is a tough horse and is second-up. SELECTIONS: YANKEE RAIN (6), ROYLANCE (4), BONA KHAN (3), THEROUX (1)

OVERVIEW: There are some talented, progressive types in this field. TOMBEUR (6) is having his second career start for Chris Svanosio. On debut, he raced in the breeze and was too good. He had a similarly tough run last start and was only caught late by some fast-finishing swoopers. I am expecting an improved performance here with added race fitness and experience. SPRINGFIELD RIVER (3) is a smart performer for Kyle Marshall. He had a tough run first-up last start at Swan Hill but should enjoy a better trip here and improve with fitness. However, he will be better suited if saved for one run. ARZALI ROCKSTAR (4) is a nice filly who finished fourth last start behind the exciting Twigstar in good time. She raced in the breeze and battled on nicely. MISTER AMERICANO (5) is a nice horse who has faced some tough competition throughout his career in feature age-group races. He is second-up here. BACK: TOMBEUR (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TOMBEUR (6), SPRINGFIELD RIVER (3), ARZALI ROCKSTAR (4), MISTER AMERICANO (5)

OVERVIEW:SOHO SPARKLE (2) had a tough run and tired late in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final for two-year-old fillies last start. She was a good third in the heat, which was only her third career start. She looks like the classiest runner in this field. MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6) has had only four career starts and is yet to miss a place. All her runs have been good, including some tough performances. She won't remain a maiden for long. VIVA STORM (4) was too far back last start but hit the line nicely to finish fourth. She showed a nice turn of foot and, with a good run, will be flashing home. Similarly, MIDNIGHT MOJO (3) is a great sit sprinter who can capitalise with the right run. BACK: SOHO SPARKLE (2)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SOHO SPARKLE (2), MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6), VIVA STORM (4), MIDNIGHT MOJO (3) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:EL LAZZAR (2) is racing in peak form and has the best barrier draw out of the major chances so he should prove hard to beat. He led throughout when a soft winner in a mile rate of 1.55.9 at Melton at his latest attempt. BELLA LOUISE (7) is also racing extremely well and should be competitive despite the poor draw. She defeated Major Drama (won since) at a Ballarat victory on October 01 and her recent third behind EL LAZZAR (2) was sound as she did all of the work in the run. LOWER MANHATTAN (11) recorded an impressive victory at Mildura when making his Victorian debut. He settled four back on the outside, came out three horses wide from the 800m and sustained a strong run to win clearly so he is worth thought again. FEEL THE REIGN (5) scored against similar opposition at Swan Hill two starts ago and has the speed to figure in the finish. OZZIE DAYBEAK (8) finished strongly at his first run since June and rates as a value chance. SELECTIONS: EL LAZZAR (2), BELLA LOUISE (7), LOWER MANHATTAN (11), FEEL THE REIGN (5)

OVERVIEW:TALKNPLAY (7) has performed extremely well at his two starts since December and is a good chance of completing a hat trick. He completely dominated his rivals when scoring by a very large margin at Kilmore last outing and scored with something in hand at Swan Hill prior. BETTOR DOO (5) finished off best from a nice trailing position when he scored at Melton last outing. He is awkwardly drawn but is meeting a field of similar quality and should go well again. FLEUR BELLA (6) began quickly to find the lead and kicked on strongly to defeat EAGLEYE (9) at Mildura last outing. She has won three of her past five starts and looms one of the leading chances again. THE AFRICAN QUEEN (10) finished off nicely for third at Mildura last outing and rates as a value hope. BACK: TALKNPLAY (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: TALKNPLAY (7), BETTOR DOO (5), FLEUR BELLA (6), THE AFRICAN QUEEN (10)

OVERVIEW: STORMS COLLIDE (7) began quickly to lead from the pole position, copped plenty of pressure down the back straight in a sizzling third quarter of 26.9 seconds and peaked late when fourth in the Super Series Final last outing. His overall form is very strong and he is sure to make his presence felt. FOX DAN (9) got past STORMS COLLIDE (7) and won the Super Series Final at his latest attempt so he should prove hard to beat again. He did enjoy the perfect trip when he scored last time out and is not as well drawn but he boasts the very good record of thirteen wins from just twenty-four starts. CALEXICO (8) pushed forward to park without cover from the 1100m and proved to be too strong in a handy mile rate of 1.54.3 at Swan Hill last outing. He is awkwardly drawn but should run his usual honest race. SOAP AND BUBBLES (6) finished strongly to score at Melton prior to a reasonable fourth in the Ladyship Cup. She is a classy mare and is worth a ticket each way. BACK: STORMS COLLIDE (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: STORMS COLLIDE (7), FOX DAN (9), CALEXICO (8), SOAP AND BUBBLES (6)

OVERVIEW: STAR VISION (7) created a big impression at his first three starts prior to contesting Super Series events. He drops back to a more suitable assignment now and is sure to be strongly fancied. HUXHAM CHUBB (3) produced a career best performance to win at Hamilton on Monday, where she settled down last and sustained a strong run in the final lap to win easily. This is a race of more depth but she is worth thought again. MAJOR DRAMA (2) is stepping up in class but is racing in great form and produced a big finale last time out. He is worth thought along with the fast beginner MIDNIGHT PIRATE (5), which has been racing in good form at Mildura. SELECTIONS: STAR VISION (7), HUXHAM CHUBB (3), MAJOR DRAMA (2), MIDNIGHT PIRATE (5)

OVERVIEW:THE FINAL DANCE (3) was competing in the Super Series (eighth in the Final) prior to a convincing win in a mile rate of 1.55.3 at Geelong then followed with a ninth in a heat of the Victoria Derby. He has been racing in strong grade and is drawn to give a bold showing. MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (10) returned from a spell in style with a convincing win at Mildura then finished unplaced after enduring a tough run on that track last time out. He won a heat of the Mildura Cup earlier in the season and was runner up in the Ouyen Cup so he has the class to test this field. BIZZNESS CLASS (7) is terribly drawn but he has been racing in outstanding form at Metropolitan level and he should be hitting the line strongly. LOUGLE (9) has won six races for the season and has been racing at a high level. He broke stride in the latter stages when looking a big winning chance at Swan Hill last outing and is worth another chance. TO THE NINES (6) is a versatile pacer that is racing in peak form and must be considered as one of the winning chances. He produced a big finish when an eye-catching third at Mildura two starts ago then didn’t have much room in the straight last outing. SELECTIONS: THE FINAL DANCE (3), MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (10), BIZZNESS CLASS (7), LOUGLE (9)

OVERVIEW:HOUSE PARTY (7) won the Mermaid Stakes in South Australia before competing in the Super Series where unplaced behind the star mare Theartofsuccess in the Final. She was surprisingly beaten into third ($1-12 fav) at Ballarat last outing but she worked hard in the run and is capable of bouncing back against this line up. THE END (4) was performing extremely well at the trials prior to winning softly against the Maiden class at his debut. He is a promising juvenile pacer and should go well again. FULL CRUNCH AHEAD (5) was resuming since January when he moved through to trail the leader at the 500m and worked into third behind Hez Harrywho at Shepparton. He should be fitter from that performance and is worth an investment. QUEENS BOULEVARD (6) is a fast beginner and is racing in good form. She led throughout at Stawell on September 14 and is capable of filling a place despite her wide draw. SELECTIONS: HOUSE PARTY (7), THE END (4), FULL CRUNCH AHEAD (5), QUEENS BOULEVARD (6)

OVERVIEW: ALTO CORAGGIO (1) has been runner up in all of his three starts to date and deserves to break through for a win. He pushed forward to find the lead and was run down in the latter stages when a close second behind Beryl’s Boots last outing. EVA EXPRESS (4) led out then took cover and finished fourth behind Pet Wolf in a slick mile rate of 1.54.9 at Melton last outing. She finished a close up fourth (2m) on debut and she should be competitive under these conditions. TAMALIA (3) attempted to lead throughout when a close third at Shepparton then followed with an unplaced effort in the race won by Pet Wolf at Melton. She might find this assignment to be more suitable and is worth a place ticket. KELCH (6) is yet to be placed in six starts to date but this is a slightly easier assignment so he is a possible improver. BACK: ALTO CORAGGIO (1) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: ALTO CORAGGIO (1), EVA EXPRESS (4), TAMALIA (3), KELCH (6)

OVERVIEW: TOORAM DANNY (4) settled midfield and finished off strongly to win easily at Swan Hill then took on a strong field when fifth behind Decode at Melton last outing. He appears to be well placed against this line up and looms as a strong winning chance. CRACKIN PHILTRA (5) pushed forward to find the lead, ran along at a good tempo and scored comfortably at Kilmore last outing. He is yet to miss a place in four starts to date and recorded a slick final half last time out so he should give another forward showing. XLENDI STAR (2) is resuming since a third at Mildura in May but will be fitter after finishing in third at a Bacchus Marsh trial on Saturday. He did well in two starts at his first preparation of racing and cannot be underestimated. CHAINSMOKE (3) produced a strong finish from midfield to score at Swan Hill when resuming then struck trouble and lost his chance at Kilmore. He is a speedy type and is a winning chance against this line up. BACK: TOORAM DANNY (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TOORAM DANNY (4), CRACKIN PHILTRA (5), XLENDI STAR (2), CHAINSMOKE (3)

CRAYONS TO PERFUME (4) will look to get back into the winner's circle in this No More Than Four Wins event after being more than competitive in the open mares race last week. OUR WILLOW (1) will be looking to make use of the pole draw, where they will have options whether to lead all the way or take a sit, but she looks to get her chance to be in the money yet again. ANGEL ROCKS (3) returns from a let-up and you would expect her to continue improving, being the lightly raced four-year-old mare that she is. UNMATCHED (6) uses the driver claim to gain entry into this race and was racing well in the four-year-old features last preparation. He could be hard to hold out if some of the more fancied runners set a decent tempo throughout. Selections:CRAYONS TO PERFUME (4), OUR WILLOW (1), ANGEL ROCKS (3), UNMATCHED (6)

Most of these went around at Burnie last week from the standing start, where REPETITIVE (1) broke through for a deserved victory. He should sit on speed with the other quick beginner in OUR BETTER BRO (2) and give the rest of the field something to chase. SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (5) can never be ruled out in these types of races. The remainder of the field probably have a little more class than the front runners but face slight handicaps over the middle distance, where TULLAH GIRL (6) and ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (9) look the best of those coming off their Burnie runs. Selections:TULLAH GIRL (6), ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (9), OUR BETTER BRO (2), REPETITIVE (1)

It's a low-class event of the night, where JAY MILLER (3) will be looking for back-to-back victories after putting in a dominant display as an even-money favourite last start, going on to win by 10.6 metres. He should be able to settle on speed from the draw here and take some beating over the mile. FIVE STAR SHARK (6) resumes from a let-up and has blistering gate speed when right, so expect them to push forward hard from the draw. He hasn't been at his best for a while now, but if he's able to recapture some of his best sprinting form, he could take some catching. TUFFTIGER (2) resumes from a let-up for a new stable and gets his chance to run an improved race, while STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8) and KIAVINO STRIDE (11) look the best of the back-row runners if there is some tempo on throughout. Selections:JAY MILLER (3), TUFFTIGER (2). FIVE STAR SHARK (6), STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8),

Another race over the mile distance, where DOLCE DRAMA (6) will be looking to use her sharp gate speed to find a spot near the front. Her past three performances have been good enough to take out a field such as this if she is able to find a handy position. DAISYPEA (3) should be able to settle on speed with cover and gets her chance to improve, while she could be hard to hold out if she recaptures her good two-year-old form. MY BAD (5) has put together some improved performances of late but strikes an awkward front-row draw here. With some luck in running, she could still be in the finish. GOT THE GLOW (2) could be hard to beat if she brings her best behaviour from the nice draw, while GOBSMACKED (10) looks the best of the back-row runners and should be storming home if there is any genuine tempo throughout. Selections:DOLCE DRAMA (6), GOT THE GLOW (2), DAISYPEA (3), GOBSMACKED (10)

A high-class race of the night brings together a competitive field, where there looks to be good gate speed early again over the short distance. LAID BACK (5) continues to loom as a winner and should be able to find a nice spot on speed and again be right there in the finish. COUNTY COURT JUDGE (1) was a handy winner in a similar field last start and gets a nice draw to sit on speed and get his chance with any luck. OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (2) has put together a good record since arriving in the state and gets back to the mile distance, where she is best suited. Her chances would improve further if she was able to be first to the pegs here. HAY MIKI (3) and KOSTYUK LEIS (4) are always thereabouts in these sorts of fields and will also be hoping to find spots on speed in what looks a very even race. Selections:LAID BACK (5), COUNTY COURT JUDGE (1), OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (2), HAY MIKI (3)

OUR DANCE MONKEY (1) was a very dominant winner last week after disappointing as a well-fancied runner at her previous starts. She looks likely to hold the lead which could make her very hard to run down if she brings last week's performance again. A DRAGON FOR JOE (2) looks clearly the testing material. Tactics will be interesting to see if they decide to duck to the pegs behind the expected leader in the small field, but on his prior performances he should be hard to hold out late with a nice run in transit. MORIKAWA (4) showed great ability as a two-year-old and has been off the scene for over 12 months. If he puts his best foot forward and steers better than he has in previous trials for the new camp, he could easily be winning here, so the market may be the best guide. Expect the winner to come from those three favoured runners, while COOLANDCOLLECT (5) and NATIONAL NEWS (3) look the best of the rest and consistently earn cheques for their connections. Selections:OUR DANCE MONKEY (1), A DRAGON FOR JOE (2), MORIKAWA (4), NATIONAL NEWS (3)

COLORADO GIRL (2) broke through for her second career victory when a somewhat easy winner last week at Burnie and gets the draw here to find a nice spot on speed. She will most likely be first to the pegs, which will give them options from there. KYRGIOS (5) is threatening to break through after being the bridesmaid numerous times of late and will no doubt be running home strongly again from the awkward draw. PUNTARNO STRIDE (3) will look to use his good gate speed in an attempt to find the front but needs to improve on recent performances to be finishing off strongly enough to score. MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (7) draws the outside of the front row, so will be hoping for some tempo at some point during the race. It wouldn't surprise to see her running home strongly and proving hard to hold out if that occurs. NO NUKES SKIPPER (4) looks the best of the rest after putting together some improved performances at recent starts, while BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1) gets her chance to improve from the pole draw in this field. Selections:COLORADO GIRL (2), KYRGIOS (5), MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (7), BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1)

The maidens round out the night, where the usual suspects do battle in an attempt to break their duck. LETHAL REPLICA (5) looked like the winner last start at the 400m mark before breaking gait. If she is on her best behaviour here, you would expect her to take some holding out off that performance. VOODOO RANGER (1) and ARRIVAL TIME (3) will again look to find forward positions from their nice draws and should be in the money again, while their stablemate CRUNCHTHEGUN (7) just needs to score up and race tractably throughout to be running home strongly. REID GRANT (4) was okay first up from a long break and looks to have some improvement to come, as will HARLEY GLENWOOD (2), who also resumes from a break without a trial, making it hard to gauge exactly where he is at, but he did show some ability earlier in the year. Selections:LETHAL REPLICA (5), REID GRANT (4), VOODOO RANGER (1), CRUNCHTHEGUN (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

ALCOMBZ (2) has been racing well without winning in Victoria. Tonight he finds a much easier race from a strong draw. He looks like the one to beat. BROWN EYED KATE (5), SUPREME DOLL (4) and ITGETSBETTER (7) are also chances.

LAMBRO LOUELLA (3) was a last start winner at Horsham when she defeated DISPERSION by a half neck. She is a great chance of leading all of the way tonight. She is going to be very hard to beat. EASTBRO MIKA (6) looks like a big danger after her recent form in Victoria. BANGBANG ROBBIE (1) and WICKED THREE (2) look the next best.

YNOBE NOVA (3) has been knocking on the door for a win in tricky races across the border. She has the gate speed to lead today and she does her best racing when she can find the top. GOLD IN PARIS (5) is better than her last run and she could easily bounce back in a race like this. ALLGOOD VINNIE (2) and VILLAGE VOICE (1) are also chances.

ALWAYS BE TECHY (5) ran a very nice race from a tough draw last start at Horsham. David Drury has his stable flying at the moment and this mare finds a very winnable race tonight. MALANI JOH (3) looks like a big danger and could easily be a big improver in this sort of race. BAYSIDE VICTORY (4) and WATCH IT HAPPEN (1) are also chances.

MAYBEDONTKNOW (1) is a well bred mare with a trainer and driver who must be respected in this sort of race from the inside draw. It may pay to watch her market moves. FRENCH PLEASURE (9), WITH A BITTA LUCK (5) and OCEAN STORM (8) are also big chances in the most tricky race of the night.

LIVERMERE (4) was a winner four starts back at Ballarat. Her recent form has been consistent and she has always been around the mark. She is worth consideration tonight. ITTAKESLUV (5), THE IRISHMAN (1) and GLENFLYER (2) are also chances. Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:CASTLES IN THE SKY (5) ran a good race in the leading role when resuming at Horsham, disappointed at her next attempt then followed with a game second at Maryborough. The move to the front line is a definite advantage and she should give a forward showing. BETSY ANNE (6) trailed the leader and battled on fairly well for third behind I’m Miss Royalty at Maryborough last outing. She places more often than she wins but she strikes a very suitable assignment here and should take beating. TOUCHANDGO (7) did well after a slow beginning for third at Maryborough two starts ago then followed with a fourth behind the handy type Keayang Minnesota. He has a tough draw to overcome but is capable of running into a place. MAJOR MAX (3) is a strong trotter, which finished third after finding the front at Kilmore three starts ago. He is drawn to suit his racing pattern and is worth thought. SELECTIONS: CASTLES IN THE SKY (5), BETSY ANNE (6), TOUCHANDGO (7), MAJOR MAX (3)

OVERVIEW:AT THE DISTANCE (2) raced on the outside of the leader throughout and battled on well when a close third at Kilmore two starts ago. He led and galloped after being overtaken approaching the home turn at Maryborough last outing but he is worth another chance under these conditions. JESSICAS STORY (3) performs best when she is able to lead out then take cover so she is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. She was placed at Kilmore on September 24, where she settled three back on the markers and finished well via the sprint lane so she is worth a ticket each way. BUCKLES FOR BERRY (4) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of finding the lead shortly after the start. He endured a tough run when fifth last outing and is capable of improving on his numerical form here. ARGYLE MUSE (7) will appreciate a slight drop back in class for this assignment and finished off well for third at Maryborough on October 12 so he is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: AT THE DISTANCE (2), JESSICAS STORY (3), BUCKLES FOR BERRY (4), ARGYLE MUSE (7)

OVERVIEW: WALKING ON WATER (6) has been runner up in four of her past five starts and is ready to break through for a win. She moved up without cover in the early stages and did well for second behind Franks Alot at Maryborough on Sunday. SUFFARELL HILL (4) showed a lot of promise in four starts at her first campaign of racing and looms as the danger. She hasn’t been to the trials but she will take plenty of beating if she is somewhere near her peak. SYNTAX ERROR (3) has shown improvement at her past two attempts and was working home well at her latest second behind Wedge Tail Eagle. This race is no harder and she is worth thought again. GYM QUEEN (2) made an early move to circle around and find the lead at the 1600m when a creditable third at Maryborough on Sunday. She is a maiden from 15 starts but she has been placed 9 times and she should be competitive again. SELECTIONS: WALKING ON WATER (6), SUFFARELL HILL (4), SYNTAX ERROR (3), GYM QUEEN (2)

OVERVIEW: CONNECT THE DOTS (1) was resuming since May when she led and gave a great sight in the $75,000 Yabby Dam Farms Classic at Menangle, being beaten on the line. She is ideally drawn over the sprint distance and should take catching. KYVALLEY DAYTONA (10) sprinted quickly in the home straight to defeat KYVALLEY DANNY (2) at a recent Kilmore trial performance. He obviously has ability and must be kept safe. THECANDYBARHEIRESS (6) finished sixth in the Graeme Lang Memorial at Melton last outing, where the winner produced a slick mile rate of 1.57.6. She will find this race to be more suitable and is worth an investment. WHERDASUNDONTSHINE (11) set up a slow tempo in the lead and was beaten on the line at Geelong last outing. He is nicely bred and should continue to improve with the benefit of race experience. NONREMARKABLE (8) never appeared to be comfortable in her gait and eventually galloped on her debut. She was heavily supported first up so she is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: CONNECT THE DOTS (1), KYVALLEY DAYTONA (10), THECANDYBARHEIRESS (6), WHERDASUNDONTSHINE (11)

OVERVIEW:HAPPY ESCAPE (7) is racing in fine form and should prove hard to beat again. He has been racing on the speed in standing start events and reverts to the mobile start but his past two runner up performances have been behind the smart mare Keayang Minnesota so he appears to be well placed against this class. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (1) settled in the second half of the field and was doing his best work at the end when second behind Beautiful Sunrise at Melton last outing. He places more often than he wins but he should be competitive against this line up. BET BET HOTSHOT (2) should gain a trail just off the pace and has been racing well enough to be competitive under these conditions. RASENGAN (6) is first up since July and hasn’t been to the trials but he was racing against better opposition when he was last in work. He has claims along with MODERN HOPE (8). BACK: HAPPY ESCAPE (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: HAPPY ESCAPE (7), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (1), BET BET HOTSHOT (2), RASENGAN (6)

OVERVIEW:SONNYBOY (9) performs best when he is able to lead so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he dominated a field of similar quality last week so he is clearly the horse to beat again. KYVALLEY MISTY (5) raced without cover on the outside of SONNYBOY (5) in the final lap last week and did well to hold down second position. She is racing well and should give another honest account from her reasonable draw. ROBERT JOHN (11) is resuming since July and hasn’t been to the trials but he was competing strongly at the end of his last campaign and he should be finishing off well if he is somewhere near his peak form. LOVE WHO (8) is awkwardly drawn but was a winner under similar conditions at Shepparton on August 18 and has the speed to figure in the finish. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4) and NEDZA THRILLER (6) are both performing well enough to be worth thought in an open race. SELECTIONS: SONNYBOY (9), KYVALLEY MISTY (5), ROBERT JOHN (11), LOVE WHO (8)

OVERVIEW: BUSLIN BRODY (8) raced without cover for the majority of the trip and battled on well for third behind Kennys Son in a stronger race at Melton on Saturday night. He couldn’t have drawn worse but he is racing well enough to break through for a win under these conditions. OMNIA (5) led and faded into tenth at Maryborough on Sunday but she was meeting a much stronger field and raced fiercely in the early and middle stages. She appears to be better placed under these conditions and is worth another chance. DEEJAY DEX (9) hasn’t won a race since September 2024 but he has been placed in three of his past five starts and he did pick up ground from last at his latest creditable sixth. RASTAMON (7) trailed the leader and had his chance when a distant fifth in the race won by Kennys Son last week but he has early speed and this race is easier so he is capable of featuring prominently. SELECTIONS: BUSLIN BRODY (8), OMNIA (5),DEEJAY DEX (9), RASTAMON (7)

OVERVIEW: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1) is likely to be headed off at the start from the pole position but he will appreciate a big drop back in class for this assignment. He won the Super Series Bronze event in September, competed in the Need for Speed Prince series and he broke stride from the 1100m at his latest performance in the Scotch Notch Trot. He is a speedy type and will take holding out in the run to the finish. PIESRIDINGSHOTGUN (3) is a brilliant beginner and is likely to try and lead throughout over the sprint distance. He led when second behind Majestic Monarch at Kilmore two starts ago. ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (4) didn’t shirk the task when a creditable sixth in the Victoria Oaks last outing. This race is easier and a bold showing is expected. JOE LOU (9) broke stride and lost all chance last outing but he had four wins and two seconds at his previous six attempts. He is a strong 4yo trotter and will take beating if he delivers a fool proof display. SHEZALOVER (7) ran a cheeky race in the leading role when resuming and has claims along with DONA AMALIA (8). BACK: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1), PIESRIDINGSHOTGUN (3), ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (4), JOE LOU (9)

OVERVIEW: SHINELIKETHESUN (2) was checked and galloped at the start, settled a clear last and produced a big performance to finish second behind Miss Muscle (won again since) at Geelong then lost her chance after galloping at the 400m last outing. She is nicely drawn and will take beating against this line up. TAURAS (6) produced a dominant performance when a runaway winner at Horsham then followed with a third behind Miss Muscle. He continues to improve with the benefit of experience and looms as one of the leading chances again. ASONGOFTHEHEART (8) gained a nice trail behind the leader and got up to defeat WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (5) at Ballarat then took on a strong field in the Scotch Notch Trot. He should gain an economical run from the trailing draw and is worth an investment. FIRST IN FLIGHT (4), WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (5) and WHITERING (7) are all capable of showing up without surprising. BACK: SHINELIKETHESUN – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SHINELIKETHESUN (2), TAURAS (6), ASONGOFTHEHEART (8), FIRST IN FLIGHT (4)

OVERVIEW: PASS THE SALT (3) is a handy 3yo trotter, which will appreciate a big drop back in class on his latest performances. He went from competing in the Super Series to the Need for Speed Prince series and his latest fifth was in the Scotch Notch Trot so he gets his chance to improve under these conditions. LITTLE MISS MORGAN (10) galloped several times in the run and lost her chance at Melton last time out. She still appeared to be a chance of running in the top three when she galloped approaching the home turn. She is a very smart mare when she is able to put it altogether and cannot be left out of calculations. DOSSIER (1) has had a few chances since her latest victory but she performs best when she is close to the speed so she is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. KITTY CASH (8) should gain a nice trip from the inside of the second line and her overall form is sound so she rates as a value chance. BACK: PASS THE SALT – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: PASS THE SALT (3), LITTLE MISS MORGAN (10), DOSSIER (1), KITTY CASH (8)

TASK AT HAND (8) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on late into second behind Whata Sweety. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. MISTA WICKED (7) was forced to race without cover last time out when running a good third behind Whata Sweety. He should secure a good run off the speed and with luck at the right time can be running into the finish late. AURELIE (6) was running on nicely last time out behind Free Reign at this track after securing a good run behind the speed. She has been prone to doing things wrong but if she brings her best manners she should be hard to beat. HEIRTOTHECROWN (5) ran a good race on debut when finishing second behind Jewel Reason at Albion Park. He made a mistake in his latest outing and can look to bounce back in this race. SELECTIONS: TASK AT HAND (8), MISTA WICKED (7), AURELIE (6), HEIRTOTHECROWN (5) SUGGESTED BET: TASK AT HAND (8) to win.

HEZA DIRTY DANCER (7) was very impressive racing at this track in his second career start when sitting without cover and running out a big winner there. He draws inside the back row which looks a reasonable draw first up from a spell. WAIT WHAT (1) appears to have some gate speed and may be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He took on a stronger race last time out won by Skip To Me Lou and should appreciate what appears to be a slight step back in grade. CALL KELLY (9) was running on nicely late last time out behind Slay Queen into second. She appears to be building back towards some of her better form this campaign and should be suited by the soft trailing draw in this race. NUMBER ONE RANGER (6) draws awkwardly outside the front row in this race and may be shuffled back in the early stages. He was shuffled back early last time out and was running on late into fourth behind Slay Queen. SELECTIONS: HEZA DIRTY DANCER (7), WAIT WHAT (1), CALL KELLY (9), NUMBER ONE RANGER (6) SUGGESTED BET: HEZA DIRTY DANCER (7) to win.

BEAU STEELE (4) was restrained onto the pegs early last time out before running on reasonably late into third behind Good Word That and Yogi. He draws a touch awkwardly in this race but with the right run he should be thereabouts in this race. KEAYANG TARA (2) has good gate speed and should be able to press forward and find a prominent position. She got back two starts ago and was running on nicely into third behind Copy Writer. GHOST TRAIN (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead early before having options from there. He handed over the lead last time out and battled away well enough for third behind Major Slip Up. PARTY CHANGER (6) made a long wide run into it and did an excellent job there to keep coming late to finish third behind Major Ark and Jukebox Jet. He looks likely to be shuffled back from the draw and can be running on late again. SELECTIONS: BEAU STEELE (4), KEAYANG TARA (2), GHOST TRAIN (1), PARTY CHANGER (6) SUGGESTED BET: KEAYANG TARA (2) to win.

MAJOR ARK (1) burned to lead last time out and couldn’t quite get across early then when left to do plenty of work before fading late. She should be able to drive through and lead this time and looks hard to run down third up from a spell. ROCKIN SWEET (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader in the race MAJOR ARK (1). He was left to do the work outside the leader last time out and battled on nicely for second behind Well Said Nugget. He should be hard to hold out. MY SCIMITAR (3) led and rolled along genuine sectionals last time out while appearing to be quite keen. He should be much better sat up and saved for one run and looks to land in the right type of grade. ART OF ROCK (4) was forced to race without cover last time out which isn’t usually how he is ideally suited in races. He draws a touch awkwardly in this race but looks to have a good chance with the right run. SELECTIONS: MAJOR ARK (1), ROCKIN SWEET (7), MY SCIMITAR (3), ART OF ROCK (4) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKIN SWEET (7) to win.

MACS A DUDE (9) should secure a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. He secured a good run two starts ago and wasn’t beaten far in third behind Mighty Ideal. He should be running on late. OCTOBER RACKETEER (5) was a good winner last time out when holding the lead early and taking them all the way. He draws wider this time but if he was able to work his way to the lead early he would likely be hard to run down. DIEGO DELGADO (8) was forced to do the work last time out when well beaten there. He should secure a good run off the speed in this race and can be running into it late. LAST CALL (4) secured a good run on the pegs three starts ago and was running on strongly into a well beaten second behind the in-form The Tiger Army. If the race is run to suit she should be running on late. SELECTIONS: MACS A DUDE (9), OCTOBER RACKETEER (5), DIEGO DELGADO (8), LAST CALL (4) SUGGESTED BET: MACS A DUDE (9) to win.

THE TIGER ARMY (8) put in a huge run last time out when sitting without cover and fighting right to the line in a race taken out by Wehavtime. He draws to do no work in the early stages in this race and can be put into the race when the speed slackens after getting a good run through early. TAKE OUT (2) has very good gate speed and should be able to find a prominent position in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He has poor numerical form but should find this a lot easier than recent outings including last start when forced to do some work outside of Allmighty Max. ASHLEE NITRO (1) should get a good economical run behind the speed in this race and can be running on late. She scored another good win at this track when running over the top of Holme Boy last start after racing off the speed. MITCHELLS RUN (10) was able to find the front last time out from a wide draw and took them all the way there. He draws less favourably this time but can be running on late if the race is run to suit. SELECTIONS: THE TIGER ARMY (8), TAKE OUT (2), ASHLEE NITRO (1), MITCHELLS RUN (10) SUGGESTED BET: THE TIGER ARMY (8) to win.

LLANFAIR LLEWELLAN (3) was able to secure a good run just behind the speed last time out and was running on nicely in behind Sweet Rocky. He looks to find a race that appears a touch easier on paper and he should run well again. NAUTIE GALVINATOR (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead early before having options from there. He got back three starts ago and was running on nicely late into fifth not beaten far behind Our Ultimate Milly. MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2) has good early speed and should be able to press forward and find a prominent position in this race. He led two starts ago but just copped too much early pressure and was entitled to tire late. OPALLANE (7) should get a good run through early in this race behind a horse which is likely to be keen to hold a forward position. He was a good winner two starts ago when leading all the way at Albion Park. SELECTIONS: LLANFAIR LLEWELLAN (3), NAUTIE GALVINATOR (1), MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2), OPALLANE (7) SUGGESTED BET: LLANFAIR LLEWELLAN (3) to win.

IM BUSTED (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead early in this race at a track and distance he has previously won at. He was able to secure a good run behind the lead last time out and was running on nicely late. THE TORQUE EFFECT (2) zipped across last time out before taking a trail on Malarky and was very good there running a close up second in good time. She looks likely to secure a good run again in this race from a favourable draw and can be running on late. SAME OLD DEVIL (6) has been racing in good form recently but does draw outside the front row which appears to make things tricky for him. He was running on nicely late two starts ago behind Maywyn Valentino at this track. KEAYANG MOSCATO (5) hasn’t quite been able to recapture her best form for the stable of Donny Smith in three outings for the stable. She draws awkwardly in this race and will need to improve on recent efforts. SELECTIONS: IM BUSTED (1), THE TORQUE EFFECT (2), SAME OLD DEVIL (6), KEAYANG MOSCATO (5) SUGGESTED BET: IM BUSTED (1) to win.

LOCH LAMOND (7) put in what appeared to be a career best effort last time out when closing strongly to run them down in the concluding stages rating fast time. He appears to draw quite awkwardly inside the back row and will need luck at some stage to get into the clear. KICK THE SWITCH (8) looks likely to get a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. He was able to track Mister Seaside into the race three starts ago and proved too good rating good time. He should be running on late again. MAJOR CRUNCH (5) drew poorly last time out when shuffled a long way back and was running on late into fifth. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. PUMPKIN PAT (3) has very good gate speed and may launch forward in the early stages to attempt to find the front. She worked hard early five starts ago before taking them all the way there in a much weaker race. SELECTIONS: LOCH LAMOND (7), KICK THE SWITCH (8), MAJOR CRUNCH (5), PUMPKIN PAT (3) SUGGESTED BET: MAJOR CRUNCH (5) to win.
